props.title: Checkpoint: the pause
props.subtitle: Probe done, receipts done, scale-up in flight — verdicts wanted before the converter wave
props.meta: 2026-08-15 · queue: probe / receipts / scale-up → pause → converter / verdict / smoke

props.content: Three things happened since the last report. The synthetic-trained splitter met real ATC transmissions for the first time — it holds up better than the raw number suggests, and its one true weakness is now a named data fix. The FAA grounding pass receipted two patterns and honestly refused two more, correcting our templates against the actual book. And the vocab-register defect you flagged is fixed at the tables, consumed everywhere, regenerated, tested, and synced. The full-size v3 generation is running now; the train_v8 converter, your sample verdict, and the DeBERTa smoke are queued behind this pause.

props.label: Probe
props.title: Synthetic-trained splitter vs real exam transmissions
props.subtitle: Read-only; no training, no gold touched. Cardinality proxy: predicted command count vs gold frame count.

props.label: dominant error: over-split by one (156 rows)

rows: Granularity disagreement
The splitter cuts surface units the command gold folds away: wind reports inside takeoff clearances, "you're number five" status tails, traffic call-outs. Most of the +1 over-splits are this.
Comma dependence

Run-on transmissions with no punctuation under-split — "make a left three sixty on downwind for spacing traffic piper on extended base..." comes back as ONE segment (gold: 3). The synthetic corpus over-relies on comma connectors.
Clean structured turns
Comma-joined instruction sequences split perfectly, including 4-command transmissions: radar contact ‖ maintain 3,500 ‖ direct Modesto ‖ report traffic.

props.title: How to read 42.5%
props.content: The proxy compares surface segmentation against command-modeled gold, which are different domains — advisory tails are real radio content the gold intentionally folds. The honest signal: structured instruction sequences split essentially perfectly; punctuation-free speech is the one named weakness, and the v3 commission raises comma-free joins and advisory-tail compounds specifically to close it. Real cut-position gold does not exist for exam rows (boundary-seed law), so count agreement is the strongest legal probe.

props.label: Grounding
props.title: FAA receipt verdicts — the book won twice

rows: report {pattern_leg}
7110.65BB 3-10-11 'REPORT (position if required)' + 3-10-1g sanctions pattern legs as reporting points
enter {leg} runway {rwy}
AIM 4-3-2 'PROCEED SOUTHWESTBOUND, ENTER A RIGHT DOWNWIND RUNWAY THREE ZERO' — slot-for-slot
information {code} is current
FAA surface has no copula: 'Information CHARLIE current' (2-9-2c1). v3 drops the 'is' and receipts the canonical form
maintain vfr at or below {alt}
'AT OR BELOW' exists only for Special VFR (7-5-4). Plain VFR is 'MAINTAIN VFR CONDITIONS ABOVE/BELOW (altitude)' (7-1-2). v3 re-surfaces accordingly

props.title: Reality-first held
props.content: Both refusals kept needs_receipt with the canonical alternatives documented in the pattern file rather than forcing a receipt onto a surface the book does not prescribe. The template fixes are ordered in the v3 commission.
props.next: v3 emits only receipted surfaces for these two families.

props.label: Data defect
props.title: Vocab registers: fixed at the tables, live bug caught

rows: Two explicit digit registers
phonetic_digits.json keeps the TTS register (fife/tree, all radio and readback consumers untouched) and adds spoken_corpus_digits (five/three/niner) with a typed accessor on the authority catalog
Altitude form tags
8 bare flight-level triples tagged bare_flight_level (not standalone clearance surfaces); explicit FLIGHT LEVEL twins added for FL110 and FL240
Generator hand-maps deleted
DIGIT_REGISTER, the substring altitude filter, and the register rewriter all replaced by the managed tables; both ponytail debts paid
Live corpus bug fixed
v2 had leaked 60 'tree'/'fife' sequence ordinals ('number tree') into training text; corpus regenerated clean, flight-level surfaces now sampled
Retrain on corrected corpus
Splitter still perfect: 1.0 test sub-sentence and cardinality, 100% alignment, 0.947 transfer; stage-2 intent 0.92, slot F1 0.91
Baseline + sync

Scorecard run complete — template corpora nominal (B1 4%, B2 2% fail), A-corpus red is the standing burndown state, change surface proven inert to scoring paths. Full-boundary sync pushed (data + parent), interleaved with the concurrent gold session's checkpoints

props.title: One honest limitation
props.content: Baseline reports are untracked, so there is no exact prior-scorecard diff to cite. The pre-existing claim rests on the proven-inert change surface (TTS register byte-identical, new key consumed only by the POC generator, altitude entries loaded by nothing in production) plus nominal template-corpora numbers.

props.label: Verdict wanted
props.title: Sample sheet — your eyeball call
props.subtitle: Representative v2 compounds. Two carry honest realism flags; say kill or keep and v3 inherits the ruling.

props.content:
AMENDMENT family (say-again restatement, verbatim echo)
  november niner five zero charlie romeo say request and i say again say request
  and descend and maintain two thousand five hundred
  -> comm_request # comm_request # altitude_instruction

GROUND compound (then-joined)
  november one seven six hotel hotel verify assigned altitude six thousand , then hold
  short of taxiway charlie one , then monitor longview tower one one niner point two ,
  then i say again monitor longview tower one one niner point two , then say intentions
  -> verification_request # hold_short # frequency_change # frequency_change # comm_request

PATTERN + SEQUENCE compound
  november three one eight romeo sierra enter left downwind runway zero six , roger ,
  report downwind , i say again report downwind , resume own navigation
  -> pattern_entry # acknowledgment # report_request # report_request # route_amendment

ATIS + SPEED compound (comma-joined)
  november two six zero alpha kilo reduce speed to two six zero knots , i say again
  reduce speed to two six zero knots , verify assigned altitude flight level four five
  zero , information sierra is current
  -> speed_assignment # speed_assignment # verification_request # informational

rows: "roger" mid-compound

ATC rarely sandwiches a bare acknowledgment between its own instructions — 'roger' composed as a non-lead segment reads synthetic. Kill acknowledgment from non-lead draw, or keep for splitter robustness?
verify-altitude + ground taxi mix

'Verify assigned altitude' composed into a taxi/hold-short transmission is phase-legal (any-phase pattern) but reads odd mid-taxi. Tighten the phase bucket, or accept as plausible pre-departure chatter?
'is current' surface
Already ruled: the book says 'information sierra current' without 'is' — v3 fixes the template, so this sample's surface dies on its own.
